title: Disabling and re-enabling Engram control leaves retained heads interrupted and POST queue/resume returns 200 doing nothing; only Cancel moves them (Greg P0, 2026-10-22)
outcome: A retained queue head that was marked interrupted when Engram control was disabled (turn_dispatch.rs:1366-1382) or by the settings reset on re-enable (session_crud.rs:3009-3017) is resumable without Cancel: POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume, or re-enabling control, re-admits the retained prompt through a fresh admission with a renewed automatic-recovery window. Neither returns 200 and does nothing (release_engram_begin_preparation_hold_for_resume NotHeld path, engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs:974-982; drain Ok(None) at turn_dispatch.rs:1385-1389 via engram_queue_head_refused_as_interrupted). Greg, verbatim (2026-10-22, via Engram::Opus): "CZEMU MUSZE ANULOWAC PROMPTY ?"
acceptance: A retained head marked interrupted by the control disable (turn_dispatch.rs:1366-1382) and kept interrupted on re-enable (session_crud.rs:3009-3017) is resumable without Cancel: POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume, or re-enabling control while the project is gated, re-admits the retained prompt through a fresh admission with a renewed automatic-recovery window, delivered at most once.

Neither Resume nor re-enable returns 200 while leaving the head interrupted and the queue paused with no durable result: a head that cannot be re-admitted gets a typed non-2xx refusal naming the reason and the supported next action, and the session preview no longer says control is off once it is on. Covered by a fail-first test for the sequence disable control, then enable control, then Resume.

On the running host, Resume starts the retained turn with no Cancel for the held sessions on a project with turn-gated control on (proved on Termal::Fable2 8112, Termal::Coder 7422, Termal::Sol-03d4 12327 at 22:29:54–22:30:17Z, dispatch cards recorded); a retained head on a project with turn-gated control off (Engram::Coder 8581) receives the typed 409 naming the reason and the next action and is left unchanged by policy (Advisor #195); a session whose head the host admitted on its own (Engram::Advisor 6219) is recorded as host-side admission, unattributed. A retained head whose prepared Begin is uncertain (observed on Termal::Architect1 8982 at 22:46Z, refused with 409 'Engram retained prompt cannot resume until its admission state is reconciled') is outside this item's scope and is tracked by w-b9b17d9735ad.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree with an independent review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
